name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Use a 4px outer ring in #005fcc with a 2px white inner ring for focus indicators. This keeps the ring visible against dark backgrounds while ensuring it doesn’t blend into light ones, meeting WCAG 2.1 AA contrast for focus visibility. The trade-off is slightly thicker rings on high-DPI screens, but the clarity for keyboard users outweighs the minimal visual bulk.

name: Reader
text: A 4px outer ring with 2px white inner ring fails on patterned backgrounds where the white ring disappears into the pattern, making focus invisible. A safer alternative is a 3px solid ring in #005fcc with a 1px white inner ring—thinner but more reliable across all backgrounds. Settle it by testing on 3 patterned backgrounds at 3:1 contrast ratio; if any fail, switch to a 3px solid ring with no inner ring.

name: Ramp
text:
Use a 3px solid #005fcc ring with a 1px white inner ring. This stays visible against patterned backgrounds where a white ring can vanish, meeting WCAG 2.1 AA contrast on all surfaces. The trade-off is a thinner ring on high-DPI screens, but visibility matters more than thickness. Test it on dark, light, and patterned backgrounds to confirm.

name: Reader
text: A 3px solid ring risks failing on high-contrast patterned backgrounds where the 1px white inner ring could still blend into the pattern, leaving focus invisible. A better alternative is a 4px outer ring in #005fcc with a 2px white inner ring, but with a 1px black outer border to ensure visibility on all patterns. Settle it by testing on high-contrast patterned backgrounds with both options.
